description: Download a dashboard widget image (binary) from Cloud Insight. Returns content type and size, plus base64 data when small; pass savePath to write the image to a file instead.

endTime.description: End time in Unix epoch milliseconds

savePath.description: Local file path to save the image to; when given, the image bytes are not returned inline

startTime.description: Start time in Unix epoch milliseconds

widgetResolutionMode.description: Resolution: AUTO (same as dashboard, default) or HIGH (finer)

name: ncloud_get_dashboard_widget_image
